messages:
Maya Patel: hey everyone :wave: I'm starting Monday and want to confirm my onboarding security steps. I have a company MacBook but plan to set up a personal Linux laptop for occasional dev work. Quick Qs:
- Is FileVault mandatory on the company Mac?
- Do we require disk encryption on personal Linux? (LUKS?)
- How do I get a YubiKey provisioned and the timing for PhishSim training?

Evie (People Ops): welcome! :tada: FileVault is mandatory on company Macs. For Mac run:
```bash
fdesetup status
```
If it says 'FileVault is On' you're good. For personal Linux we recommend LUKS (not required) but if you want network access you'll need to enroll your device in MDM or use the bastion jumpbox. YubiKey provisioning: ping @Alex Chen in 1:1 or open the hardware token request form: https://tiny.redwood/tokens . PhishSim training is auto-enrolled, you'll get the first campaign ~48 hours after account creation.

Maya Patel: thanks! I'm seeing 'FileVault is Off'. @Evie — can IT push an enable or should i do it myself?

Alex Chen: I can enable remotely if you can leave it connected to power & network for ~20min. Otherwise you can enable manually:
```bash
sudo fdesetup enable
```
I'll start the ticket now @Evie

PhishSim Bot: PhishSim: Maya Patel has been enrolled in the new-hire campaign. First simulation scheduled in 2 days. No action needed.

Jamal Ortiz: FYI contractors have a slightly different timeline — if your laptop is personal and you're contractor please check with @Evie about exemption forms.

Maya Patel: i'm a full time hire, thanks. One more — do we have a time window for setting up 2FA keys? I prefer to pick up a YubiKey at HQ.

Evie (People Ops): you can pick up during week 1. We'll reserve one at the front desk if you reply with preferred pickup day. For remote folks we ship within 3 business days. Also file the hardware token request so Alex can pre-register it.

Alex Chen: ticket created #IT-5237. I'll remote-enroll FileVault in the morning unless you prefer to run it now. LMK.

Maya Patel: please do remotely tomorrow morning. Thanks all :lock:
